llms.body:
# Broadsign

> Broadsign is the leading global platform for managing and monetizing out-of-home (OOH) advertising. Founded in 2003 in Montreal, Canada, Broadsign powers more than 2.8 million static and digital signs across roadways, airports, shopping malls, grocery stores, transit systems, and more in 107 countries. The platform serves over 48 billion ads and 193 billion impressions per month, connecting media owners and buyers through end-to-end software for planning, managing, and transacting OOH media.

## Platform Overview

Broadsign offers two main suites of solutions: one for **media owners and retailers** (to sell, manage, and monetize OOH inventory) and one for **agencies and brands** (to plan, buy, and deliver programmatic DOOH campaigns).

---

## For Media Owners

### Broadsign Platform
The end-to-end solution for media owners to scale, manage, and sell digital and static OOH inventory through automated software, intelligent campaign tools, network operations, and programmatic advertising.
URL: https://broadsign.com/broadsign-platform/

### DOOH Ad Server
Unifies direct and programmatic campaign management into a single workflow. Supports goal-based, slot-based, and programmatic campaign types. Features guaranteed booking with automatic mid-flight rebalancing to ensure delivery. Eliminates the need for multiple platforms and manual spreadsheets.
URL: https://broadsign.com/ad-server/

### Content & Network Management
Manage and automate digital out-of-home media and operations across networks of any size. Features include automated content scheduling (playlist-free), remote network monitoring, proof-of-play reporting, and system-on-chip (SoC) compatibility.
URL: https://broadsign.com/content-network-management/

### Static Campaigns
Centralized asset management and campaign booking tool for static OOH inventory. Syncs with real-time work order status, stock levels, and bill poster communications.
URL: https://broadsign.com/static-campaigns/

### Place Exchange SSP (Global Programmatic SSP)
Broadsign's supply-side platform connects media owners to 55+ DSPs and global omnichannel buyers. Features brand safety filters, automated auctions, strategic pricing tools, and seamless integration into existing tech stacks.
URL: https://broadsign.com/global-programmatic-ssp/

### Local Signage Messaging
Tools for managing locally-relevant content and messaging across OOH networks.
URL: https://broadsign.com/local-signage-messaging/

### Broadsign In-Advance
Automates direct OOH transactions, bringing the speed and ease of programmatic to direct deals. Eliminates the RFP/email back-and-forth between media owners and buyers. Enables automated, guaranteed in-advance deal execution.
URL: https://broadsign.com/broadsign-in-advance/

### System-on-Chip
Broadsign software support for smart screens (SoC devices), enabling network operators to expand compatible hardware.
URL: https://broadsign.com/system-on-chip/

### DOOH more with Broadsign
Broadsign’s flexible selling tools help media owners automate campaign management and rebalancing, enabling them to book 10% more campaigns. By optimizing inventory and filling gaps, owners can drive higher revenue and efficiency.
URL: https://broadsign.com/dooh-more/

---

## For Media Buyers, Agencies & Brands

### OutMoove DSP
Broadsign's purpose-built DOOH demand-side platform. Delivers global inventory, transparency, and control for media buyers to plan, buy, and optimize data-driven programmatic DOOH campaigns.
URL: https://broadsign.com/outmoove/

### Audiences
Data-driven audience targeting for DOOH campaigns powered by mobile data (in partnership with Native Touch). Targets venues by 6 key audience groups and 190+ personas including age, income, gender, interests, life stage, and purchase intent.
URL: https://broadsign.com/audiences/

### Measurement & Attribution
Measurement solutions in partnership with industry-leading data providers. Includes brand lift studies, foot-traffic studies (store visit attribution), and web/app lift studies to link OOH exposure to real-world and digital results.
URL: https://broadsign.com/measurement-attribution/

### DSP Partners
Launch and manage programmatic DOOH campaigns from existing DSPs. Broadsign's SSP is integrated with 55+ DSPs worldwide for seamless omnichannel activation alongside existing digital campaigns.
URL: https://broadsign.com/dsp-partners/

### Inventory Catalog
Browse Broadsign's global network of digital screens across high-impact venue types including airports, billboards, grocery stores, malls, transit hubs, and urban panels.
URL: https://broadsign.com/inventory-catalog/

### Launch a Programmatic DOOH Campaign
Broadsign helps media buyers launch and optimize programmatic DOOH campaigns globally. Users can target audiences using their preferred DSP or the dedicated OutMoove DSP across 1.7+ million premium digital screens.
URL: https://broadsign.com/launch-pdooh-campaign/

### Measurement & Attribution
Broadsign partners with data providers to track digital out-of-home ad performance. Marketers can measure brand lift, foot traffic, online engagement, and point-of-sale data to calculate accurate campaign ROI.
URL: https://broadsign.com/measurement-attribution/

---

## For Retailers

### In-Store Retail Platform
End-to-end platform for retailers to manage and monetize in-store digital advertising. Features flexible delivery options, dynamic campaign triggers (weather, location), and full integration with retail media strategies.
URL: https://broadsign.com/in-store-retail-platform/

### Digital Signage for Retail
Broadsign’s retail digital signage platform helps businesses build, scale, and monetize in-store media networks. It offers automated scheduling, real-time inventory visibility, and open integrations to drive ad revenue and shopper engagement.
URL: https://broadsign.com/retail-digital-signage/

### Blog Feed for Retail Media Networks
Broadsign's retail blog and resource hub. It focuses on the rise of retail media networks, offering reports, activation insights, and guides to help retailers monetize and scale in-store digital signage networks.
URL: https://broadsign.com/retail-media-networks/

---

## Industry Verticals

Broadsign provides specialized digital signage solutions for the following verticals.

### Airports
Automated, optimized digital signage for airport networks
URL: https://broadsign.com/airports-digital-signage/

### Banking
In-branch and ATM digital signage
URL: https://broadsign.com/banking-digital-signage/

### Casino
Entertainment and wayfinding digital signage
URL: https://broadsign.com/casino-digital-signage/

### Cinema
Pre-show and lobby digital signage
URL: https://broadsign.com/cinema-digital-signage/

### EV Charging
Advertising screens at EV charging stations
URL: https://broadsign.com/electric-charging-stations-digital-signage/

### Gas Stations
Forecourt and convenience store digital signage
URL: https://broadsign.com/gas-stations-digital-signage/

### Healthcare
Patient engagement and wayfinding
URL: https://broadsign.com/healthcare-digital-signage/

### Hotels
Guest-facing digital communications
URL: https://broadsign.com/hotels-digital-signage/

### Internal Communications
Employee-facing digital signage networks
URL: https://broadsign.com/internal-communications-digital-signage/

### Outdoor / Billboards
Roadside and large-format digital OOH
URL: https://broadsign.com/outdoor-digital-signage/

### Retail
In-store retail media networks
URL: https://broadsign.com/retail-digital-signage/

### Shopping Malls
Tenant and brand advertising in mall environments
URL: https://broadsign.com/shopping-malls-digital-signage/

### Smart Cities
Municipal and public space digital networks
URL: https://broadsign.com/smart-cities-digital-signage/

### Transit
Advertising across bus, metro, and rail networks
URL: https://broadsign.com/transit-digital-signage/

---

## Plans & Pricing

Broadsign offers Standard, Professional, and Enterprise plans for media owners, covering content and network management, digital media management, automated campaign scheduling, network and player management, API access, and more. For agencies and brands, Broadsign connects buyers to media specialists to build campaign strategies.
URL: https://broadsign.com/plans/

---

## Company

### About Broadsign / Who We Are
Broadsign is the leading global provider of cloud-based digital signage and DOOH software, empowering media owners, buyers, and retailers to connect with audiences at scale.
URL: https://broadsign.com/who-we-are/

### Our Story
Founded in 2003 in Montreal, Canada. Over 20 years of shaping the out-of-home industry. Broadsign powers 2.8M+ signs in 107 countries, serving 48B+ ads and 193B+ impressions per month.
URL: https://broadsign.com/our-story/

### Careers
Job openings for developers and industry experts building software that powers billboards and screens around the world. Offices in Montreal and other global locations.
URL: https://broadsign.com/careers/

### Contact
Broadsign has offices in Montreal, New York, Toronto, Berlin, Sydney, Shanghai, Amsterdam and Saint-Louis.
URL: https://broadsign.com/contact/

---

## Resources

### Blog
Industry insights, guides, and news on digital signage and DOOH advertising.
URL: https://broadsign.com/blog/

### Resources Hub
eBooks, webinars, and educational content on digital signage, programmatic DOOH, buying, selling, and OOH technology.
URL: https://broadsign.com/resources/

### Events
Industry events, summits, and Broadsign Connect gatherings worldwide.
URL: https://broadsign.com/events/

### Documentation
Technical documentation for Broadsign platform products including Guaranteed Campaigns and other modules.
URL: https://broadsign.com/documentation/

---

## Legal & Compliance

### Privacy Policy
https://broadsign.com/privacy-policy/

### Privacy Policy for residents of California
https://broadsign.com/privacy-policy/california/

### Privacy Policy for residents of the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland
https://broadsign.com/privacy-policy/europe/

### Website Terms of Use
https://broadsign.com/website-terms-of-use/

### Data Processing Addendum
https://broadsign.com/data-processing-addendum/

### Sustainability Statement
https://broadsign.com/sustainability-statement/

### Security Statement
https://broadsign.com/security-statement/

### Legal
https://broadsign.com/legal/

---

## Languages

The Broadsign website is available in: English, French (fr), German (de), Spanish (es), Japanese (ja) and Chinese (zh). A few pages are availahle in Portuguese (pt), Indonesian (id), and Dutch (nl).

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const videos = document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-video video');
    
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                entry.target.play().catch(error => {
                    console.log("Autoplay prevented: ", error);
                });

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem("submitted-forms");
    if (raw) {
      const ids = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(ids)) {
        for (const id of ids) {
          const safe = String(id).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, "");
          if (!safe) continue;
          document
            .querySelectorAll(".hide-for-" + safe)
            .forEach((el) => el.remove());
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('error with reading HS localStorage');
  }

  const seenParents = new WeakSet();
  document.querySelectorAll(".sidebar-cta-block").forEach((el) => {
    const parent = el.parentNode;
console.log(parent);
    if (!parent) return;
    if (seenParents.has(parent)) {
console.log('removed');
      el.remove();
    } else {
      seenParents.add(parent);
console.log('make visible');
      el.classList.add("sidebar-cta-block--visible");
    }
  });
});

function triggerHubspotFormOnModalLoad(elementID) {
const formDiv = elementID.target.querySelector('#xxxxx');
    formDiv.querySelectorAll('script').forEach(oldScript => {
        const newScript = document.createElement('script');
        for (const attr of oldScript.attributes) {
            newScript.setAttribute(attr.name, attr.value);
        }
        newScript.textContent = oldScript.textContent;
        oldScript.parentNode.replaceChild(newScript, oldScript);
    });
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section[id]');
  const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('#careers-submenu .navbar a[data-scrollspy]');
  const mobileHeader = document.getElementById('careers-submenu-mobile-header');
  if( sections.length && navLinks.length ) {
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      const id = entry.target.id;
      const link = document.querySelector(`.navbar a[data-scrollspy="#${id}"]`);
      if (!link) return;

      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        link.classList.add('navbar-active');
        mobileHeader.innerText = link.textContent.trim();
      } else {
        link.classList.remove('navbar-active');
      }
    });
  }, {
    rootMargin: '-25% 0px -75% 0px' // Adjust when the active state should trigger
  });

  sections.forEach(sec => observer.observe(sec));

  // Optional: Instantly update active class when a nav link is clicked
  navLinks.forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', () => {
      navLinks.forEach(l => l.classList.remove('navbar-active'));
      link.classList.add('navbar-active');
      mobileHeader.innerText = link.textContent.trim();
    });
  });
}
});
</script>

<script>
  (() => {
    const minScale = 0.92;
    const pairs = [];

    for (const list of document.querySelectorAll('.feature-list')) {
      const cards = list.querySelectorAll(':scope > .feature-shrink');
      for (let i = 0; i < cards.length - 1; i++) {
        pairs.push({ card: cards[i], next: cards[i + 1] });
      }
    }

    if (!pairs.length) return;

    let framePending = false;
    function updateScales() {
      framePending = false;
      const scales = pairs.map(({ card, next }) => {
        const style = getComputedStyle(card);
        if (style.position !== 'sticky' || style.top === 'auto') return 1;
